licence.frontierhunts.expedition.relaxed: Relaxed regulations: carry a Hunting Licence (free after the Archery course), a tag for big game and a stamp for game birds, and hunt in season. Buy them standing at an expedition board, on the Licence & Tags page of the Hunter's Journal. A first violation is a warning, then small fines.
licence.frontierhunts.expedition.strict: Strict regulations: carry a Hunting Licence, a tag for big game and a stamp for game birds, and hunt in season. Buy them standing at an expedition board, on the Licence & Tags page of the Hunter's Journal. Violations are fined, half the meat and the trophy are seized, and three strikes suspend the licence for the season.

licence.frontierhunts.page.mode.2.desc: Every violation: a fine and a strike, half the meat and the trophy seized. Three strikes suspend the licence for the season.

Relaxed: the first violation of a season is a warning, after that a small fine. You keep the animal, but it never counts for a species hunt.
Strict: every violation is a fine and a strike; half the meat and the trophy are seized; three strikes suspend your licence for the season.

onboard.frontierhunts.task.licence.title: Get your hunting licence
onboard.frontierhunts.task.licence.how: Pass the Archery course and the Ranger Academy issues a free Hunting Licence, or buy one at an expedition board (Hunter's Journal: Licence & Tags). Big game also needs a tag, game birds a stamp.
onboard.frontierhunts.task.licence.card: Get a Hunting Licence (free after the Archery course).
onboard.frontierhunts.task.camp_cook.how: Craft a Camp Dutch Oven, set it on a campfire (or feed it coals), add meat and vegetables - bowls for stews - and take out the dish. Camp meals give a short buff.
onboard.frontierhunts.task.camp_cook.car: Cook a camp meal in a Dutch oven.
